description: Reads the construction stage definition of the open CIVIL NX model with the Construction Stage Reporter plugin's engine and returns, per stage: duration and day range, the structure groups activated (with age and element count) and deactivated (with redistribution), boundary groups activated (deformed/original position) and deactivated, load groups activated/deactivated (first/last day), composite section parts (db/CSCS) that start acting, and the elements and boundary entities active after it. Also the composite sections, the whole-model summary, and the plugin's consistency checks (a group deactivated before it was activated, groups no stage uses, elements never activated, groups a stage names but the model lacks…). Read-only. elementIds: true adds the activated/deactivated element ids per stage; groups: true adds a row per group.

elementIds.description: Add the element ids activated and deactivated in each stage (as ranges, e.g. '1-40, 52').

groups.description: Add one row per structure, boundary and load group: members and the stages that switch it.

stages.description: Stage names to report (default: every stage).

name: cs_stage_summary
title: Construction Stage Reporter — stage summary
